answer: Every claim enters a jade grove tournament: each identity pays one thread of stake, and single-elimination rounds run until one stands. Guaranteeing one fake through k rounds needs a full 2^k-clone bracket, burning 2^k - 1 threads so one emerges. Each guaranteed fake costs 2^k threads: 32 at 5 rounds, 1,024 at 10 rounds. One honest thread beats an exponential clone bill, so faking never pays.
